name: capacity: unconstrained within-family diagnostic
decision: Stop at Stage B. Stages C and D are NOT run. No grid expansion, per REGISTRATION section 6.
split: validation only; the test split was never read
what_was_measured: Does a prespecified label-free A-side code T retain a residence advantage over the SAME-HOST untouched-J release, before any privacy constraint? Probe family is the house utility family (logistic + mlp, selection by validation log loss), on the historical subset indices.

0.adjusted_note: unadjusted one-sided 95%; a family adjustment is applied at report time

1.adjusted_note: unadjusted one-sided 95%; a family adjustment is applied at report time

2.adjusted_note: unadjusted one-sided 95%; a family adjustment is applied at report time

B2_deployable.note: Intervals are reported on their own merits per AMENDMENT_1 section 4, not withheld because historical precision was poor. Bootstrap unit is the household.

subsumption_check.reading: T ALONE beats the prior by 0.014 to 0.022 nats in every seed, so the code carries genuine residence signal. J alone beats T alone in every seed. Adding T to J does not improve on J and is slightly worse. The code residence-relevant content is therefore already subsumed by the released service predictions; this is not a case of compression destroying signal.

B1_fitted_model_ceiling.verdict: NOT RELIABLY ESTIMABLE at this sample size

probability_decile_partition.note: negative values are a variance artifact: 10 baseline cells times 64 codes is 640 cells on 2984 rows

B1_fitted_model_ceiling.reading: Conditioning on any reasonably fine baseline view crossed with 64 codes exhausts the 2984 validation rows, which is exactly the near-unique-conditioning failure the review warned about. B1 is reported as unestimable rather than as a number; G2 rests on B2, which is unambiguous.

P2.text: Stage B shows a residence advantage over same-host J that is positive but under .003 nats
P2.outcome: REFUTED - the advantage is NEGATIVE in 3 of 3 seeds at both resolutions, not positive-but-small

P3.text: Stage B shows no usable residence advantage at the declared resolution, stopping the study at the first gate

honest_note: I registered P2 at 55 percent and P3 at 30 percent. P3 is what happened, so I was wrong about the more likely of the two, and wrong in an optimistic direction.
what_this_does_not_establish: Not a capacity theorem. A different code, a different probe family or a different resolution could differ.
Not a statement about the ACS population; these are repeatedly used 2018 development pools.
Not a claim that randomization cannot help. The constrained mechanism was never reached, because the UNCONSTRAINED release already fails.
